remediation.suggestion: Keep inline code only for UI labels and paths, and avoid placing shell-like examples in skill prose unless required.

remediation.issue: Paid workspace references may look like reconnaissance keywords to automated scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Continue framing workspace guidance as user-facing navigation, and avoid mentioning internal systems or private implementation details.

remediation.suggestion: Keep the destination domain explicit and avoid instructing agents to submit sensitive personal, payment, or credential data.

content.value_statement: First responders need clear paths to verified home buying support, but program pages can be hard to interpret. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through public results and paid workspace context.
actual_capabilities: Guides searches by state, role, support type, and repayment style.
Explains verified matches, under-review signals, and deeper opportunity teasers.
Directs users from homepage results to state pages and program detail pages.
Separates free statewide discovery from paid Research Vault workflows.
Provides safe language that avoids eligibility, underwriting, or lender approval claims.
limitations: Does not replace official program documents or professional lending guidance.
Does not calculate mortgage payments, rates, or underwriting outcomes.
Does not access private workspace data without the user already having access.
May require live website review for current program availability.

use_cases.title: Check Statewide Options
use_cases.description: Find verified statewide programs for a specific state and first responder role.
use_cases.target_user: First responder researching home buying support

use_cases.title: Review Caution Signals
use_cases.description: Interpret zero-match results, under-review signals, and deeper opportunity teasers without overclaiming eligibility.

use_cases.title: Navigate Paid Research
use_cases.description: Guide a paid user toward workspace tools, saved scenarios, comparisons, and Research Vault records.

prompt_templates.title: Find Programs by State
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for public statewide matches.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the FirstResponder Program Finder for my state and role. Start with verified statewide matches, then explain any under-review signals.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret No Matches
prompt_templates.scenario: A search returns zero verified results.
prompt_templates.prompt: The finder shows zero verified matches. Check whether optional filters should be cleared and explain what under-review or deeper signals may mean.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Public Results
prompt_templates.scenario: User needs a structured explanation of programs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the state page and program detail pages. Summarize support type, amount, repayment terms, official documents, and limits on eligibility claims.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Paid Workspace Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for paid research context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through the paid workspace for deeper local, specialty, employer, pension, and historical research records. Separate verified programs from records needing judgment.

output_examples.input: I am a Texas firefighter looking for home buying assistance.
output_examples.output: Start with the homepage finder, enter Texas and firefighter, and review verified matches first. Then open the Texas state page for statewide context and official details.

output_examples.input: The search says zero verified matches for my filters.
output_examples.output: Reset support type and repayment to Any, then search again. If verified matches still do not appear, review under-review signals and deeper opportunity teasers.

output_examples.input: I paid for the Decision Pack and need local options.
output_examples.output: Go to the account workspace and open the Research Vault. Treat records marked current, judgment needed, historical, or blocked as different research categories.

best_practices: Start with verified statewide results before mentioning under-review or deeper records.
Open official documents and program pages before summarizing rules or repayment details.
Use cautious wording for eligibility, availability, and approval status.
anti_patterns: Do not present the website as a lender, quote tool, or pre-approval system.
Do not treat every Research Vault record as a current verified program.
Do not stop at zero matches before checking filters and caution signals.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps agents navigate FirstResponderHomePrograms results, state pages, program pages, and paid workspace guidance.

faq.question: Can it confirm that I qualify for a program?
faq.answer: No. It can explain site information and official documents, but eligibility must be confirmed through the program source or lender.

faq.question: Does it only cover free public pages?
faq.answer: No. It covers free finder pages and explains how paid users can navigate workspace features.

faq.question: What should I do when there are no verified matches?
faq.answer: Clear optional filters first, then check under-review signals and deeper opportunity teasers for the state.

faq.question: Does the skill access private account data?
faq.answer: No. It only provides navigation guidance and requires the user to control any signed-in account access.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
